class.name: VertexMobileSettings
class.brief_description: Touch-friendly editor layout settings for the Vertex mobile editor.
class.description: Centralizes sizes and gesture thresholds so the editor is re-laid-out for small touchscreens and virtual keyboards rather than simply shrunk. Used by the Vertex mobile editor plugin.

method.name: from_dictionary
method.description: Loads settings from a dictionary produced by [method to_dictionary].

method.name: to_dictionary
method.description: Serializes all settings to a dictionary.

members.member: Height of the compact toolbar in dp.
Minimum pan distance before a touch is treated as a drag.
Size of collapsible-panel toggle buttons in dp.
Whether dock panels are collapsed to maximize editing area.
Override screen density in dp (0 = auto-detect).
Minimum touch-target size in dp for interactive controls.
Whether to assist layout adjustments for the virtual keyboard.
